chunks: "Turn cold, O fire," We said, "and give safety to Abraham."
ai.seo_question: What did God command the fire to do for Prophet Abraham?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a manifestation of divine favor (tawfiq) where the fire's nature was altered to suit Ibrahim's state of faith, serving as a precursor to the concept of 'coolness of the eye' (kullu 'ayn). The transformation underscores the principle that God's command can override natural laws to protect His chosen prophets, reinforcing the theme of divine preservation amidst trials.
